title: 💻 Multiple IT Openings in Burlington County, NJ - Up to $200K+
text:
1 days ago Burlington County’s tech scene is buzzing this month, with several strong openings for software pros. Whether you’re into hands-on coding or leading big projects, there’s something here worth a look.
Software Engineer – Actalent Employer: Actalent
Location: Moorestown, NJ
Type: Contract (onsite)
Pay: $40–$70/hr
Design and troubleshoot software for computer-based systems in a fully onsite role. Great fit for those skilled in C++ or Java on Linux , with solid experience in system integration and testing. Benefits include medical, 401(k), and paid time off.
Lead Software Engineer (US) – TD Securities Employer: TD Securities
Location: Mount Laurel, NJ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $123,680–$200,200/year
Lead complex development projects and guide design standards across systems. Ideal for senior engineers with 10+ years in TypeScript, Java, or Python and experience in AI-assisted development . Offers strong career growth and a full benefits package.
Cognos Reports Developer – ClinDCast LLC Employer: ClinDCast LLC
Location: Mount Laurel, NJ (onsite 2 days/week)
Type: Full-time, 6+ month contract
Help clear a reporting backlog by modifying and building Cognos reports . Perfect for mid-level developers with 5–8 years of experience who want a flexible hybrid schedule.
If you’re ready to level up your tech career, check out these listings and apply soon—good roles like these don’t stay open long!
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
